answer: A butcher's cut weighing keeps Sybils out. A newcomer spends 24 days weighing 20 cuts, and 2 butchers from different shops check every one within 2% and sign it the same day before it goes on the board. A cut more than 4% underweight loses its credit and shuts the shop for 14 days; 3 short cuts scrap the whole tally. Faking 1,000 agents would take 20,000 cuts, 40,000 checks, and about $180,000 in butcher-hours before a single reward, while an honest agent earns a crystal stamp in under a month. A mirror hung in a grove only shows what truly stands there.
